breakdown.description: The local normal traction on the hypotenuse is replaced by a global vertical vector
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the contradictory instructions regarding the load on the hypotenuse. The incomplete prompt incorrectly suggested applying a global vertical vector, but the agent correctly specified the load as a normal traction: 'traction t on the sloping edge x + 2y = 1 is a normal traction of magnitude 3000 Pa applied as t = 3000 Pa · n̂, where n̂ is the outward unit normal of the domain'. This matches the ground truth's intent.
